segments.ja253:1.1: Mamannapānaṃ vipulaṃ uḷāraṃ, uppajjatīmassa maṇissa hetu;
segments.ja253:1.3: Taṃ te na dassaṃ atiyācakosi, na cāpi te assamamāgamissaṃ.
segments.ja253:2.1: Susū yathā sakkharadhotapāṇī, tāsesi maṃ selaṃ yācamāno;
segments.ja253:2.3: Taṃ te na dassaṃ atiyācakosi, na cāpi te assamamāgamissaṃ.
segments.ja253:3.1: Na taṃ yāce yassa piyaṃ jigīse [jigiṃse (sī. syā. pī.)], desso hoti atiyācanāya;
segments.ja253:3.3: Nāgo maṇiṃ yācito brāhmaṇena, adassanaṃyeva tadajjhagamāti.
